five_minutes: US tariff law could hit Indian exporters, adding downside risk to export‑sensitive stocks.
RBI Treasury Bill auction adds ₹24 bn of short‑term supply, likely nudging G‑sec yields higher.
State bond auction of ₹16,750 cr adds mid‑term supply, capping upside for sovereign yields.
IT‑services export survey shows robust growth, supporting IT equities and services surplus.
RBI ODI data release signals continued foreign capital interest, influencing USD‑INR and equity flows.

Gold and silver will NOT rise further even in a recession, because they are already at all-time highs
Nifty 29-Sep futures will fall below 23,000 before expiry

buckets.label: What you need to know today

items.headline: US tariff law could hit Indian exporters, adding downside risk to export‑sensitive stocks
items.what_happened: A new US law proposes steep tariffs on Indian goods, creating uncertainty for bilateral trade.
items.why_it_matters: Potential tariffs raise export costs, could depress earnings of Indian manufacturers and affect the trade balance, weighing on the INR and export‑linked equities.

items.headline: RBI releases August ODI data, signalling continued foreign capital interest
items.what_happened: The Reserve Bank of India published overseas direct investment figures for August 2026 under both automatic and approval routes.
items.why_it_matters: Foreign inflows affect the USD‑INR differential and can shape FII sentiment, feeding into equity and bond market dynamics.
items.update_note: Carried over from yesterday with new reporting.

items.headline: IT‑services export survey shows robust growth, supporting IT equities and services surplus
items.what_happened: The RBI released its annual survey on software and IT‑enabled services exports for 2025‑26, indicating strong export volumes.
items.why_it_matters: Strong services exports underpin India’s trade surplus and buoy IT‑sector stocks, reinforcing a positive outlook for export‑linked equities.
items.update_note: Carried over from yesterday with new reporting.

items.headline: Canada signals near‑term India trade deal, could lift commodity and infrastructure exposure
items.what_happened: Canadian officials expressed optimism about concluding a trade agreement with India by year‑end.
items.why_it_matters: A deal could open new markets for Indian agribusiness, energy and infrastructure firms, supporting sectoral equities and potentially boosting export earnings.

items.headline: Railways approves multiple infra projects, indicating higher fiscal spending on transport
items.what_happened: Indian Railways gave approval to several infrastructure projects across the network.
items.why_it_matters: Increased infrastructure spending can boost demand for construction, steel and engineering services, supporting related equities and credit outlooks.

items.headline: GOBARdhan procurement rules released, tightening CBG offtake for dairy, may affect agri‑linked stocks
items.what_happened: The government issued GOBARdhan rules governing the offtake of cow‑breeder‑generated milk by the Centralised Buying Group.
items.why_it_matters: New offtake mechanisms could improve cash flows for dairy processors, influencing valuations of agri‑sector equities.

items.headline: RBI Treasury Bill auction adds ₹24 bn of short‑term supply, likely nudging G‑sec yields higher
items.what_happened: The Reserve Bank of India announced auction of 9 bn 91‑day, 8 bn 182‑day and 7 bn 364‑day Treasury Bills.
items.why_it_matters: Increased short‑term debt supply can lift near‑term yields, pressuring the 10‑yr G‑sec curve and may prompt investors to demand higher risk premia on equities.
items.update_note: Carried over from yesterday with new reporting.

items.headline: State bond auction of ₹16,750 cr adds mid‑term supply, capping upside for sovereign yields
items.what_happened: State governments offered securities totalling ₹16,750 crore, including a 7.56% Andhra Pradesh SGS 2039.
items.why_it_matters: Mid‑term supply may support current 10‑yr G‑sec yields, limiting price appreciation and influencing fund flows into banking and infrastructure stocks.
items.update_note: Carried over from yesterday with new reporting.

items.headline: Anand Rathi highlights castrol India, NHPC, Vikram Solar as sub‑₹200 picks, suggesting value opportunities
items.what_happened: Mint · Markets published a list of stocks under ₹200 with target prices and stop‑loss levels.
items.why_it_matters: Identifies potential equity underweights/overweights for portfolio construction, especially in energy, power and renewable segments.

items.headline: RBI raises CRR/SLR for local area banks, tightening liquidity for smaller lenders
items.what_happened: The RBI issued second amendment directions increasing cash reserve ratio and statutory liquidity ratio for local area banks.
items.why_it_matters: Higher reserve requirements constrain loan growth at LA banks, affecting credit supply and risk metrics for the banking sector.

items.headline: RBI amends priority‑sector lending targets, raising benchmarks for banks
items.what_happened: The RBI released third amendment directions revising priority‑sector lending (PSL) targets and classification.
items.why_it_matters: Revised PSL targets increase credit exposure to agriculture and MSME, influencing banks’ asset‑quality metrics and sectoral credit outlooks.

items.headline: RBI reviews FEMA circulars, signalling upcoming simplifications in cross‑border FX compliance
items.what_happened: The RBI issued a review of circulars issued under the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999.
items.why_it_matters: Regulatory simplifications may reduce compliance costs for corporates engaging in foreign exchange transactions, affecting capital flow efficiency.
items.update_note: Carried over from yesterday with new reporting.
